Hero_Desc_BigWood:
A brawny wood elemental.
However, if you actually get close enough to have a conversation with her, she apparently says things that send a chill down your spine.
She doesn't really have any evil intentions... probably.
Album_Hate_BigWood: Boredom and dullness. Situations requiring her to read the room.
Album_Wish_BigWood: Having her roots in a nice place.
Album_BigWood1:
BigWood is a reliable, and patient, tree elemental.
Though an elemental, she inexplicably resides in the sprite village.
Album_BigWood2:
Asked why she chose to live in the sprite village, she expressed a dislike for the subtle competitiveness among the elementals.
The sprites seem to accept BigWood, as they living side by side.
Album_BigWood3:
That said, some sprites seem to mistreat BigWood mercilessly.
They kick her, to get fruit, or strip her bark, to decorate their houses.
Shocked, I intervened, only to have BigWood get angry herself.
Album_BigWood4:
BigWood seems to be(...) secretly enjoying the sprites' harassment.
She may proudly say, 'I am a giving tree, who gives with no regrets'...
but based on her unchanged expression... it seem she has complex feelings.
Album_BigWood5:
Ner, the sprite priestess, genuinely treats BigWood well.
Could it be because she is the closest elemental form to resemble the Yggdrasil Ner serves?
It's rare to see Ner so kind...
Album_BigWood6:
Funny enough, BigWood actually finds Ner annoying.
Of course she is grateful, but Ner's a bit stuffy... And Ner, like me, often prevents BigWood from being bullied.
Ner insists she is simply trying to be nice to her.
Album_BigWood7: One day, Ner finally realized BigWood's true nature and joined in on the teasing. While BigWood's stiff wooden face radiated pure happiness, I could only shake my head.
LoveHero_BigWood:
Hop on BigWood, Master!
BigWood
will protect you!
LoveHeroCancel_BigWood:
I guess being abandoned doesn't feel too bad.
Hehe...
It's a new kind of thrill...!
Food_ChefNote_BigWood_Hate1: BigWood said she had no interest in magical minerals that couldn't be used as fertilizer, wearily leaving the restaurant.

BigWood said she had friends in the forest.

LoveCall_BigWood:
Mmm, Master! At last, the call connected!
BigWood's hands are so large that pressing the buttons was difficult.
But hearing your voice makes all the trouble worthwhile!

Actually, BigWood has been working to grow a fruit especially for you lately.
BigWood is a Tree Elemental who is kind to everyone, but BigWood wants to give the Master a special fruit.
Because the Master has always treated BigWood warmly!

Someday... BigWood will grow a fruit filled with BigWood's sincere feelings for the Master alone.
Then the Master can squeeze that fruit very firmly... with the finest technique...! Huff, huff!
Hm? You think you should end the call? Mmm, the Master truly is busy.
BigWood will call again. Until then, look forward to the fruit of BigWood's efforts, grown and brought forth for the Master alone!
